lines.t: (Minimal high-pitched synth pluck loop, heavy 808 kick)
(Loud throat clear, animated deep male voice)
Yeah! Throw your hands up!
(Gritty female voice in background) (OKURRRRT! LET’S GO!)
Look!
[Verse 1 - Lead Male Vocal, Animated Flow]
(Animated, fast, booming delivery, sharp punchy accents)
Debt free! He cancelled out the whole invoice! (INVOICE!)
Enemy was talkin', but I made the right choice!
I ain't signin' contracts with the world's stress,
Got my name written down in a higher press! (UP TOP!)
Dead to the flesh, man, I'm living in the Spirit,
Truth so loud that the whole world hear it!
Walking by faith, put the sight on mute,
Tree by the water, yeah, you gotta check the fruit! (CHECK IT!)
Devil brought a lawsuit, thought he had a case...
Lawyer in the Heavens threw it OUT by Grace! (GET OUT!)
[Chorus - Both Vocals]
Paid in full! (PAID IN FULL!)
Paid in full! (PAID IN FULL!)
Zero balance left, yeah, paid in full!
Spirit taking over while the flesh gets dull!
Glory to the King, put the flex on freeze,
Serving up the Word while I'm down on my knees!
[Verse 2 - Featured Loud, Gritty Female Vocal, Bronx Cadence]
(Booming, raspy, loud street-talk delivery, sharp inflections)
(OKURRRRT! LOOK!)
They want a big bag, I just want the full armor!
Reaping what I sow, yeah, I'm workin' like a farmer! (WORK!)
Cross on my neck and the favor run deep,
Promises of God are the only ones I keep!
Walk through the valley, I ain't shaking at the knees,
Principalities bowing down, freeze! (BOW DOWN!)
Old life buried, new life risen,
Broke out the chains and I walked out the prison! (WHAT!)
[Chorus - Both Vocals]
Paid in full! (PAID IN FULL!)
Paid in full! (PAID IN FULL!)
Zero balance left, yeah, paid in full!
Spirit taking over while the flesh gets dull!
Glory to the King, put the flex on freeze,
Serving up the Word while I'm down on my knees!
[Verse 3 - Lead Male Vocal, Double-Time Flow]
(Rapid-fire, animated, hyper-articulate delivery)
Hold up! Let me take it back to square one!
Hold up! Let me take it back to square one!
Serving up the Father and the Spirit and the Son!
Rushing through the city with the Kingdom mentality,
Switching up the mindset, changing the reality!
No cap, no fake, no phony façade,
Standing on the Word and the power of God! (POWER!)
Put the enemy on notice, tell him pack up his bags,
Trading in the ashes for the royalest rags! (LET'S GO!)
Standing on the Word and the power of God! (POWER!)
Put the enemy on notice, tell him pack up his bags,
Trading in the ashes for the royalest rags! (LET'S GO!)
[Bridge - Extended Breakdown]
[Beat Stop - 808 Pulse Only]
(Male Voice) No weapon formed against the blood-bought team!
(Female Voice) Living out the vision, living out the real dream! (FACTS!)
(Male Voice) Charges dropped, man, the record wiped clean...
[Beat Stop]
(Both Vocals) Cleanest washed soul that you EVER done seen! (OKURRRRT!)
[Chorus - Both Vocals]
Paid in full! (PAID IN FULL!)
Zero balance left, yeah, paid in full!
Spirit taking over while the flesh gets dull!
Glory to the King, put the flex on freeze,
Serving up the Word while I'm down on my knees!
[Outro]
Case dismissed!
Zero balance!
Paid in full! (WHAT!)
